correctness.rationale: The W5 graph is K5 minus disjoint {1,2},{3,4}. Graphical-zonotope normal cones come from realizable 8-edge sign vectors; weak orders of five labeled potentials suffice (5^5 scores), giving exactly 389 cones and 26 primitive connected bipartition rays. Independent enumeration gave dimension/ray profile (0,0):1,(1,1):26,(2,2):116,(3,3):160,(3,4):8,(4,4):58,(4,5):20. All simplicial cones have unimodular primitive determinants per source exact lattice verifier; nonsmooth minimal cones are 8 dimension-3 four-ray cones and 4 dimension-4 five-ray cones. Each dimension-3 minimal cone lies in two distinct maximal cones, no two share a maximum; closures are eight disjoint P1; isolated four maxima yield four points. Eight one-dimensional torus orbits plus 16 endpoints and four isolated fixed points = 28; 20 nonsmooth fixed points of 78 total. Primitive relations in the source checker are (1,1,-1,-1) and (1,1,1,-1,-1), with all rank-maximal minors unit, yielding respectively conifold and rank-one 2x3 Segre semigroups and multiplicities 2 and 3. Every nonsimplicial cone is singular and all simplicial cones unimodular, hence nonsmooth support is precisely non-Q-factorial support. The computed fan is exhaustive, not a random sample.
